data.name: Chaos Company🔥
data.detailed_description:
In a world consumed by plague, madness, and war, survival belongs to those willing to kill for coin. You play as a ruthless mercenary hired to hunt undeads, monsters, and heretics across cursed lands crawling with death.

Take dangerous contracts, collect rewards, and grow stronger with every run. Fight through brutal third-person 2.5D combat using melee weapons, firearms, explosives, and forbidden relics. Every mission offers new enemies, randomized loot, and deadly encounters where one mistake can cost everything.

You are not a hero.
You fight for money.
And the Company always has another mission waiting.

Features

  • Fast-paced third-person 2.5D action combat

  • Randomized upgrades and loot

  • Hunt undeads, monsters, cultists, elfs and corrupted beasts

  • Upgrade gear, weapons, and mercenary abilities

  • Complete missions and defeat bosses

  • Multiple build combinations

No mercy. No faith. Only payment.
